definitions: take, hold, or deploy (something) as a means of accomplishing a purpose or achieving a result.
employ (a system, method, or technique) for a particular purpose.
exploit (a person or thing) for one's own advantage.
take or consume (a quantity of something) from a supply.
spend or exhaust (a resource) in the course of an activity.
do something with (a particular quality or ability) as a way of achieving a result.
be a regular customer at (a shop, restaurant, or other business).
examples: I used a knife to cut the bread.
She used her charm to get what she wanted.
We use a lot of electricity in winter.
He used up all his holiday allowance.
You should use your common sense.
I use the local library often.
